The work addresses the limitations of existing methods that use multi-view diffusion models (like Zero-1-to-3) for 3D generation.

It identifies a critical bias in the unconditional noise predictions of these models and proposes a rectification strategy using the unconditional noise from a pre-trained 2D diffusion model (Stable Diffusion).
